title: Orders pipeline
subtitle: Spark on a job scheduler · daily · order events → sales views

does: Gives analysts one current, flat copy of every order
Splits each order into lines, discounts and shipments
doesnt: Doesn't take orders — the order system does
Doesn't manage who can read the data
limitations: Data is up to one day old
A failed run is not retried automatically

top_issues.text: Some shipments can go missing when two share a number
Removed order lines may still be counted

items: What
Collects every order update from the order system and keeps only the latest version of each order.
Why
So nobody has to read raw order messages to answer a question about an order.
Key idea
The newest update of an order replaces the older one; older updates that arrive late are ignored.
Result
Simple tables analysts can read directly, ready every morning.
